name: BMX CITY RUN VR
summary: Embark on an exciting VR cycling journey where you explore diverse locations on your trusty bike and perform thrilling stunts with full immersion. In each mission, earn points by pulling off daring tricks, then spend them on new bike models with unique designs. Whether you're riding through urban streets, a vibrant amusement park, or a radioactive wasteland, every trip becomes a new, adrenaline–filled adventure.
